name: mre-ai
description: Martinrea AP platform - root launcher for the backend services + frontend.

scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n wf,ing -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend/workflow run start:dev" "npm --prefix backend/ingestion run start:dev"
scripts.predev: npm run ports:free && npm run infra:up
scripts.dev: concurrently -n wf,ing,web -c blue,green,cyan "npm --prefix backend/workflow run start:dev" "npm --prefix backend/ingestion run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start:backend: concurrently -n wf,ing -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend/workflow run start:prod" "npm --prefix backend/ingestion run start:prod"
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend/workflow run build && npm --prefix backend/ingestion run build
scripts.seed: npm --prefix backend/workflow run seed && npm --prefix backend/workflow run seed:rules
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend/workflow install && npm --prefix backend/ingestion install && npm --prefix frontend install
